title: Constraints and data integrity
brief: Express identity, required values, row checks, references and exclusions in enforceable schema rules. Preserve tenant integrity with composite identities and references, and distinguish declarative enforcement, triggers and invariants needing a concurrency protocol.

neighbouring_ownership.access-control: Owns who may read or change rows.
neighbouring_ownership.transactions: Owns concurrent protocols for rules beyond declarative constraints.
neighbouring_ownership.history: Owns correction and deletion policy; constraints applies that policy to references.

title: SQL at the application boundary
brief: Preserve query meaning and transaction ownership across drivers, pools and ORMs. Separate parameters from SQL structure, map results, bound repeated queries, and handle one request’s connection, error and cancellation coherently.

neighbouring_ownership.capacity: Owns pool sizing, admission and overload.
neighbouring_ownership.outboxes-jobs: Owns durable external intentions and worker recovery.
neighbouring_ownership.access-control: Owns authority of application and administrative identities.

title: PostgreSQL roles, policies and privileged code
brief: Test role inheritance, ownership and row-policy boundaries as the actual application identities. Explain bypass cases and secure privileged routines against identity and name-resolution mistakes.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-extensions: Owns extension installation and lifecycle privileges.

title: Operating and securing a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Verify secure runtime identity, least privilege and tenant isolation. Use native evidence to diagnose under-replication and range health, then remove a node without consuming the cluster’s survival budget.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-performance: Owns expensive query and hot-key repairs.
neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns general movement and membership safety.
